items.q: Eddie Sauter, and there was [were] some Stravinsky works there, and Milhaud and all other music.

ctx.x: Eddie Sauter, and there was [were] some Stravinsky works there, and Milhaud and all other music. And the Modern Jazz Quartet, John Lewis somehow said, “We’re gonna have morning/mourning clothes.” You know the morning/mourning clothes with the hickory striped pants and the white vests and the ties and the black jacket almost swallowtail, but morning/mourning, I mean real formal, ambassador’s outfit.
